description: Safe structural trace contract for geometry analyze relation diagnosis. Strips all raw model outputs, strings, values, and point labels in-memory before persisting.

preregistered_patterns.description: All required fields for recognized kind present with correct types, arity, valid point references, and zero unknown keys.
Recognized kind, but one or more required fields (e.g. line, other_line, plane) are missing.
A field exists but its received JSON type does not match schema (e.g. string instead of array).
An array field exists but its length is incorrect (e.g. line has 3 points instead of 2).
Nested element structure is malformed (e.g. array of arrays instead of array of strings).
A known field (e.g. plane in perpendicular_lines or other_line in perpendicular_line_plane) is placed in wrong relation type.
Relation object contains keys outside the allowed schema properties.
The 'kind' field contains a value not in the recognized relation kind enums.
Valid structural shape, but referenced points do not exist in the contract points list.
model_assumption is improperly set or flagged on a given fact.
Two or more structural defects occur concurrently on the same relation.
Any safe malformed relation structure that does not fit the specific patterns above.
